class.name: HTTPResponse
class.brief_description: The typed result of a request sent by [HTTPRequest].

method.name: get_header
method.description: Returns the value of the response header [param name], compared without case, or [param default] if the response has no such header.

method.name: get_json
method.description: Parses the [member body] as JSON and returns the result, or [code]null[/code] if the body is empty or not valid JSON. No error is printed for a body that is not JSON.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the [member body] decoded as UTF-8 text.

method.name: is_success
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member result] is [constant HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS] and [member status_code] is between [code]200[/code] and [code]299[/code].

members.member: The response body. It is already decompressed if the server sent it compressed. It is empty if [member HTTPRequest.download_file] was set.
The response headers as lower-case names mapped to values. Values of repeated headers are joined with [code]", "[/code]. See [member raw_headers] for the unchanged lines.
The response header lines as received, as in [signal HTTPRequest.request_completed].
The result of the transfer. Only [constant HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS] means that a response arrived; the other values describe why the request failed.
The HTTP status code of the response, for example [code]200[/code] or [code]404[/code]. It is [code]0[/code] if no response arrived.
The [HTTPRequestTarget] that was sent with [method HTTPRequest.request_target], or [code]null[/code] for requests started with [method HTTPRequest.request] or [method HTTPRequest.request_raw].
